transport.config_rules: Byte/count values are positive integers; timeout is finite and positive. Defaults allow existing 1 MiB send chunks. No manifest/config fixture changes.
transport.semantics: Payload byte/chunk/part limits are cumulative across parts. max_buffered_bytes is both the server-wide retained wire budget and each client's cumulative inbound socket/S3/file cap. Server budget includes reports, active, queued and retained completion-cache bytes, deduplicated by distinct transfer identity. Reuse/disconnect drop only that session's cache; queued bytes survive until their exact update is released. Incomplete-transfer deadline is absolute and expires without another message.
transport.s3: Existing presigned-object format/key prefix; 64 KiB HTTP streaming, Content-Length check, reserve-before-append and total deadline. Actual local aiohttp reader tests: valid, oversized header, oversized stream, malformed/truncated pickle and incomplete timeout. No live S3 credentials/service used. Review correction validates exactly-once canonical prefix normalization with actual pinned D writer/presigner and minimal adapters; no historical malformed-key migration.
transport.compatibility: Completed reports/payloads remain visible to legacy server completion hooks until assignment/disconnect/close. Default urgent communication uses report.client_id for envelope, parts, completion, simulation filename and S3 reference.
